condition: Calling FacetGrid.refline on a grid returned by lmplot draws unwanted markers at both ends of each reference line, because lmplot's hue_kws marker gets passed to axvline/axhline.
workaround: Draw the reference lines yourself with ax.axhline/ax.axvline on each of g.axes.flat instead of using g.refline, or clear g.hue_kws before calling refline.
